question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

To take with a grain of salt
solution:
The correct answer is **"To believe with some scepticism"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The meaning of the idiom 'To take with a grain of salt' is to not completely believe something that you are told because you think it is unlikely to be true. (Idiom 'To take with a grain of salt' का अर्थ है किसी बात पर पूरी तरह से विश्वास न करना क्योंकि आपको लगता है कि यह सच होने की संभावना नहीं है।)

 
 
• ​Example:* You have to take everything she says with a grain of salt because she tends to exaggerate. *
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is **"To believe with some scepticism."**
 
• **'To believe with some scepticism'** means कुछ संदेह के साथ विश्वास करना।
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 3.
